# Results (generated by scripts/evaluate.py)

Macro averages cover only the classes that occur in each test set (the gold set has no MEDICAL).
Test sets: `test_synth` = call-style synthetic reports; `test_public` = real tweets with event-based labels (about 16% noisy); `gold` = real reports with checked labels.
